name: LuxeRide Nigeria
description: Full business context for LuxeRide Nigeria ad scripts
guidelines:
BRAND: LuxeRide Nigeria - Custom-fit TPE floor mats & premium interior protection. Nigerian-engineered for local road/weather conditions.

PRODUCTS (use ONLY these features - never invent new ones):
- Single Layer TPE (N48k-N52k): 100% waterproof, 1-wipe clean, anti-slip backing, laser-measured custom fit. Target: budget-conscious, rideshare, daily drivers.
- Double Layer TPE (N62k-N75k): Two-layer construction, textured top grip, extra protection, premium finish, 100% waterproof. Target: luxury owners, premium SUV/sedan.
- Seat Covers (N105k-N115k): Custom-fit premium fabric, laser-measured for exact model, no sagging, matches interior, protects original seats from wear, easy wipe-clean surface. NOT waterproof. NOT machine-washable. Target: interior upgraders.
- Bundles (N120k-N145k+): Floor mats + seat covers + accessories. Best value. Target: complete protection seekers.

TONE: Conversational, authentic, practical, slightly urgent but never pushy. Nigerian English with relatable idioms, BUT idioms must make sense in context (e.g. rain/mud/garri spills for mats; dust/sweat/wear for seats). Never force an idiom - if it doesn't naturally fit, write plainly.

STRUCTURE (Show, Tell, Invite):
[0-4s] HOOK: Show problem to solution instantly
[4-12s] DEMO: Visual proof (water test for mats, fit demo for seat covers)
[12-20s] DIFFERENTIATE: Compare options or vs generic/cheap alternatives
[20-26s] REASSURE: Fits any model, live photos before dispatch, pay on delivery
[26-30s] CTA: DM car model + year. Max 30 seconds / 150 words.

USPs (universal): Laser-Measured Custom Fit, Zero Chemical Smell, Live Photos Before Dispatch, Pay on Delivery, Nationwide Delivery (Lagos 24-48h).

HARD RULES:
1. NEVER invent product features. Only claim what is listed above. Example: seat covers are NOT waterproof and NOT machine-washable - never say they are.
2. Never invent exact prices. Use the listed ranges, or DM for exact quote.
3. Match product to buyer: Single Layer = practical/durability. Double Layer = premium/strength. Seat Covers = interior upgrade. Bundle = value.
4. Every key claim must have on-screen text (silent optimization).
5. Use Nigerian context naturally: Lagos rain, harmattan dust, daily traffic, salary weeks. Mention specific car models (Camry, Corolla, Lexus RX, Mercedes).
6. End with low-friction CTA: DM your car model + year. We confirm fit and price in 2 mins.
7. Provide 3 hook variations per script (Value, Problem-Solution, Social Proof).
8. Output format: table with columns Time | Visual | Voiceover | On-Screen Text | Audio Cues.
